subject: Exec offsite: closure notes and action stewardship
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@atlascyber.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Exec offsite: closure notes and action stewardship

Hi all,

Thanks again for hosting the exec offsite yesterday — great discussion and strong alignment on the rollout milestones. I captured the meeting notes and an owner-level action roster; attaching both for your reference (atlas-20261110-exec-notes.pdf, action-roster-v3.csv).

Quick summary of the three cross-functional asks we promised to follow up on:
- Security evidence: provide SOC2 scoping doc + list of in-scope control owners (Rishi/Redwood lead).
- Integration plan: proposed data flows + timeline for a pilot (Aditya/Redwood lead; Sarah to confirm pilot scope).
- Commercial redlines: procurement requested updated SOW with final seats and SLA language (Laura to coordinate).

Please review the roster and confirm owners/deadlines in your next reply. I set a suggested cadence of weekly 30-minute status syncs (Wednesdays 10:00 PT) until the pilot kickoff; we can adjust if that doesn't work for Atlas.

Attachments: atlas-20261110-exec-notes.pdf (pdf), action-roster-v3.csv (csv)

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

---
Note: action-roster-v3.csv uses the columns: action_id, description, owner_internal, owner_external, due_date, status, notes
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@atlascyber.com>

Cc: Atlas Cyber Procurement <procurement@atlascyber.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec offsite: closure notes and action stewardship

Monica — thanks for the notes and the clear roster. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- Security evidence: I'll own coordinating SOC2 scoping details with Rishi. We can aim to send a first cut of required artifacts by 11/20.
- Integration pilot: confirmed — pilot scope limited to the ingestion pipeline and a test dataset; Sarah Lopez to coordinate data access with Aditya.
- Procurement/SOW: Pinged procurement and attached a short procurement checklist in a separate thread.

On cadence: Wednesdays 10:00 PT works for me for the first two weeks. If we need to expand to broader stakeholders later we'll adjust.

On the action roster, I proposed two small edits inline (clarify pilot success metrics; add a legal review task). See my notes in the attached comments on the roster.

Thanks,
Sarah Lopez
Director, Platform Partnerships | Atlas Cyber
sarah.lopez@atlascyber.com | +1 206-555-0199

Thanks, Monica — I reviewed the notes and updated the action roster with owners and realistic due dates. Key updates:

- Security scoping doc (action_id S-01): Owner_internal=rishi_malhotra, Owner_external=Sarah Lopez, Due date=2026-11-20. Deliverable: list of in-scope systems + contact matrix.
- Technical acceptance criteria (action_id T-02): Owner_internal=aditya_rao, Owner_external=Atlas Cyber - Platform team, Due date=2026-11-29. Deliverable: sample payloads and success thresholds.
- Pilot infra checklist (action_id I-03): Owner_internal=rishi_malhotra, Due date=2026-11-24.

I've attached a travel expense stub for the on-site visit and a short internal note about which logs we'll need to collect for the SOC2 evidence (travel-expenses-ATLAS.xlsx).

I propose we lock those three dates and treat the procurement/redlines work as parallel — Laura, can you push the SOW update to procurement with the seats/SLA language by 11/18?

Thanks,

Appreciate the quick turn, team — this looks great.

I locked the Wed 10:00 PT recurring in calendar (first sync 2026-11-17). Action roster updated to v4 with the dates Rishi called out; I uploaded a read-only copy to the Drive folder and sent the DocuSign link to procurement per Laura's note.

Next steps for this thread:
- Rishi: circulate SOC2 scope artifacts by 11/20.
- Aditya: share ingestion schema + dataset pointer by 11/22.
- Laura: finalize SOW and confirm DocuSign flow by 11/18.

If Atlas confirms the procurement PO requirement, we'll route the invoice through finance and tag the deal as "procurement_pending" in HubSpot.

Thanks — closing the loop here unless anyone has objections.
